method: sha256(text) hex-ascending sort over lab/data/v2/train.jsonl; take the smallest (target - old_val_rows) unique content hashes not already present in lab/data/v2/val.jsonl; union with old val kept first, in its original order; all lines whose content hash is selected (all occurrences, in case of duplicate lines) are removed from train
seed_note: recorded for manifest-schema parity with lab/data/v2/manifest.json; selection itself is a deterministic content-hash sort and does not consume this value -- there is no RNG in this script
historical_prefix_note: val_large.jsonl rows [0, historical_prefix_len) are the surviving v2 val documents, in v2 order. Slice with this field, never with a hard-coded 1943: neardup_audit.py --apply may remove some of them and updates it.

near_duplicate_check.criterion: flag a val document when some train document covers >= 0.5 of its characters with non-template windows (>= min(3, n_windows) distinct hashes), or reproduces >= 0.98 of it verbatim

frozen_reason: near-duplicate audit applied; rebuilding this directory would discard the audit and change val_large.jsonl under downstream eval artifacts
